about_the_game:
The Broken Arrow Original Soundtrack features 41 meticulously crafted tracks by Evgeny Shchukin, designed to underscore the game's expansive, tactical military gameplay. Each composition captures a full spectrum of emotion — from the tense calm of strategic planning to the adrenaline-fueled chaos of frontline combat — creating a cinematic atmosphere that heightens every decision and encounter.

Built in close collaboration with Alexander Tochilkin, the soundtrack reflects the duo’s deep roots in electronic music and sound design. With backgrounds in vinyl releases, festival performances, and interactive audio, they bring a unique blend of analog synths, orchestral elements, and dynamic scoring techniques to the project. Drawing inspiration from iconic game soundtracks and modern film scores, the music is driven by a powerful FMOD-based dynamic music engine — adapting in real time to gameplay intensity, phase transitions, and player actions.

The result is an evolving, immersive soundscape that transforms each match into a gripping audio-visual experience — with more music still to come.
